name: neo-writer
description: Minimal markdown writer with live-edit, save and render.

scripts.prepare: mkdir -p public && cp node_modules/dompurify/dist/purify.min.js public/purify.min.js && cp node_modules/mermaid/dist/mermaid.min.js public/mermaid.min.js && cp node_modules/marked/marked.min.js public/marked.min.js
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:browser
